column1: # Single source of truth for what each tool IS on each OS.
# Columns: tool  fedora  debian  raspbian  macos
# Cells:   method:name   install via that method (dnf/apt/brew/cargo/bun/npm/pip)
#          -             not available on this OS; no manifest line needed
#          fn:name       shell function in that OS's package script, for
#                        installs a cell cannot express: versioned URL
#                        downloads, arch checks, piped upstream installers,
# A comma in a name installs several packages in one call (apt:rustc,cargo).
# Row order is install order: bootstrappers first, then their dependents.
# Build prerequisites (cmake, gcc-c++, make, perl-core, curl, wget, python3-dev)
# are deliberately NOT rows: they are not preferences, and a machine that
# declined one would fail deep inside an unrelated build.
# Adding a tool: add one row here, then run scripts/gen-manifest-example.sh.
# install.sh validates every manifest key against this file.
